notes.title: 🛠️ Update: Speed Boosts, Fixes & More!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! A small but mighty update just dropped, focused on polish and quality-of-life improvements:

🔁 Same Seed Bug – This was bad, I take full responsibility.

⚡ Faster Animations – Core game animations have been sped up to keep the action flowing.

🐢 Card Follow Lag – Fixed an issue where cards couldn’t keep up if you were super fast. They’re snappier now!

🪲 Undo Bug Squashed – Monster damage wasn’t calculated properly after undoing moves. That’s been fixed.

As always, thanks for the feedback! If something still feels off—or if you just want to share your high scores—drop by the discussions 👇

Happy delving,– Sanchit

notes.content:

• Endless — Score 2 000 + in Endless mode
• Blacksmith — Repair a weapon with three or more cards stacked
• Shatterbrand — Use Shatterbrand more than five times in a single run
• Vampire — Gain more than 15 health in one room

Tip: Preview the new achievement icons in-game or check the attached image.

Thanks for Playing
Your runs, bug reports, and clips keep the project humming. If you’re enjoying the game, a Steam review helps more than you know.

Flip. Fight. Survive.
